apps.compose:
name: alcoit-secure-gateway
services:
  alcoit-secure-gateway:
    image: caddy:2.11.4-alpine
    container_name: alcoit-secure-gateway
    restart: unless-stopped
    read_only: true
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    cap_add:
      - NET_BIND_SERVICE
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -ec
    command:
      - |
        if [ ! -f /etc/alcoit-gateway/Caddyfile ]; then
          printf '%s\n' ':443 {' '  tls internal' '  respond "AlcoIT Secure Gateway is waiting for HomeApp configuration." 503' '}' > /etc/alcoit-gateway/Caddyfile
        fi
        exec caddy run --config /etc/alcoit-gateway/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile
    ports:
      - target: 443
        published: "443"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/AppData/alcoit-homelab/application-access
        target: /etc/alcoit-gateway
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/AppData/alcoit-homelab/application-access/data
        target: /data
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/AppData/alcoit-homelab/application-access/config
        target: /config
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp
    x-casaos:
      ports:
        - container: "443"
          description:
            en_US: Shared HTTPS entry point for HomeLab applications.
            es_ES: Punto de entrada HTTPS compartido para las aplicaciones de HomeLab.
      volumes:
        - container: /etc/alcoit-gateway
          description:
            en_US: Caddyfile generated and maintained by HomeApp.
            es_ES: Caddyfile generado y administrado por HomeApp.
        - container: /data
          description:
            en_US: Persistent local certificates and Caddy state.
            es_ES: Certificados locales y estado persistente de Caddy.
        - container: /config
          description:
            en_US: Persistent Caddy runtime configuration.
            es_ES: Configuración de ejecución persistente de Caddy.
x-casaos:
  id: com.alcoit.securegateway
  version: "2.11.4"
  architectures:
    - amd64
    - arm64
  main: alcoit-secure-gateway
  author: AlcoIT Software
  category: Security
  description:
    en_US: Shared local HTTPS gateway configured by HomeApp for every protected application.
    es_ES: Puerta de enlace HTTPS local compartida que HomeApp configura para todas las aplicaciones protegidas.
  developer: Caddy
  icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/AlcoIT-Software/alcoit-homelab-catalog@main/Apps/AlcoIT-Secure-Gateway/icon.svg
  index: /
  port_map: "443"
  scheme: https
  tagline:
    en_US: One secure local gateway for every HomeLab application.
    es_ES: Una puerta de enlace local segura para todas las aplicaciones de HomeLab.
  thumbnail: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/AlcoIT-Software/alcoit-homelab-catalog@main/Apps/AlcoIT-Secure-Gateway/thumbnail.svg
  title:
    en_US: AlcoIT Secure Gateway
    es_ES: AlcoIT Secure Gateway
apps.name: AlcoIT Secure Gateway

apps.compose:
name: jellyfin
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/jellyfin:10.11.11
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: "${PUID:-1000}"
      PGID: "${PGID:-1000}"
      TZ: "${TZ:-UTC}"
    ports:
      - target: 8096
        published: "8096"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/AppData/jellyfin/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/Media
        target: /media
        read_only: true
    x-casaos:
      envs:
        - container: PUID
          description:
            en_US: User identifier used for media files.
            es_ES: Identificador de usuario utilizado para los archivos.
        - container: PGID
          description:
            en_US: Group identifier used for media files.
            es_ES: Identificador de grupo utilizado para los archivos.
        - container: TZ
          description:
            en_US: Container timezone.
            es_ES: Zona horaria del contenedor.
      ports:
        - container: "8096"
          description:
            en_US: Jellyfin web interface.
            es_ES: Interfaz web de Jellyfin.
      volumes:
        - container: /config
          description:
            en_US: Persistent Jellyfin configuration.
            es_ES: Configuración persistente de Jellyfin.
        - container: /media
          description:
            en_US: Read-only media library.
            es_ES: Biblioteca multimedia de solo lectura.
x-casaos:

  icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/IceWhaleTech/CasaOS-AppStore@main/Apps/Jellyfin/icon.png

apps.compose:
name: pihole
services:
  pihole:
    image: pihole/pihole:2026.05.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    ports:
      - target: 53
        published: "53"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 53
        published: "53"
        protocol: udp
      - target: 80
        published: "8081"
        protocol: tcp
    environment:
      TZ: "${TZ:-UTC}"
      FTLCONF_webserver_api_password: casaos
      FTLCONF_dns_listeningMode: all
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/AppData/pi-hole/etc-pihole
        target: /etc/pihole
    x-casaos:
      envs:
        - container: TZ
          description:
            en_US: Container timezone.
            es_ES: Zona horaria del contenedor.
        - container: FTLCONF_webserver_api_password
          description:
            en_US: Pi-hole administrator password. Change the initial value.
            es_ES: Contraseña de administración de Pi-hole. Cambia el valor inicial.
        - container: FTLCONF_dns_listeningMode
          description:
            en_US: Interfaces where Pi-hole accepts DNS queries.
            es_ES: Interfaces donde Pi-hole acepta consultas DNS.
      ports:
        - container: "53"
          description:
            en_US: DNS port.
            es_ES: Puerto DNS.
        - container: "53"
          protocol: udp
          description:
            en_US: DNS port.
            es_ES: Puerto DNS.
        - container: "80"
          description:
            en_US: Pi-hole web interface.
            es_ES: Interfaz web de Pi-hole.
      volumes:
        - container: /etc/pihole
          description:
            en_US: Persistent Pi-hole configuration.
            es_ES: Configuración persistente de Pi-hole.

apps.compose:
name: vaultwarden
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:1.37.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    environment:
      SIGNUPS_ALLOWED: "${SIGNUPS_ALLOWED:-true}"
      INVITATIONS_ALLOWED: "${INVITATIONS_ALLOWED:-true}"
      SHOW_PASSWORD_HINT: "${SHOW_PASSWORD_HINT:-false}"
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "8082"
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/AppData/vaultwarden
        target: /data
    x-casaos:
      envs:
        - container: SIGNUPS_ALLOWED
          description:
            en_US: Allows account creation. Turn it off after creating your first account.
            es_ES: Permite crear cuentas. Desactívalo después de crear tu primera cuenta.
        - container: INVITATIONS_ALLOWED
          description:
            en_US: Allows existing users to invite other people.
            es_ES: Permite que los usuarios existentes inviten a otras personas.
        - container: SHOW_PASSWORD_HINT
          description:
            en_US: Shows password hints in emails. Disabled for better privacy.
            es_ES: Muestra pistas de contraseña en los correos. Está desactivado para mayor privacidad.
      ports:
        - container: "80"
          description:
            en_US: Internal Vaultwarden interface. Activate secure access from HomeLab before storing real passwords.
            es_ES: Interfaz interna de Vaultwarden. Activa el acceso seguro desde HomeLab antes de guardar contraseñas reales.
      volumes:
        - container: /data
          description:
            en_US: Encrypted vault data and persistent configuration.
            es_ES: Datos de la bóveda y configuración persistente.
x-casaos:
  id: com.alcoit.vaultwarden
  version: "1.37.0"
  architectures:
    - amd64
    - arm64
  main: vaultwarden
  author: AlcoIT Software
  category: Security
  description:
    en_US: Lightweight password manager compatible with Bitwarden applications, protected with LAN-only HTTPS.
    es_ES: Gestor de contraseñas ligero compatible con las aplicaciones de Bitwarden, protegido con HTTPS sólo dentro del hogar.
  developer: Vaultwarden
  icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/IceWhaleTech/CasaOS-AppStore@main/Apps/Vaultwarden/icon.png
  index: /
  port_map: "8443"
  scheme: https
  tagline:
    en_US: Your passwords, encrypted inside your home network.
    es_ES: Tus contraseñas cifradas dentro de tu red doméstica.
  thumbnail: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/AlcoIT-Software/alcoit-homelab-catalog@main/Apps/Vaultwarden/thumbnail.svg
  title:
    en_US: Vaultwarden
    es_ES: Vaultwarden
apps.name: Vaultwarden
